BiomedParseSegmentation.description: Tissue segmentation for radiology images with pixel-accurate region boundaries. Require BiomedParseClassification to follow it.

BiomedParseClassification.description: Tissue classification for radiology images. Must follow BiomedParseSegmentation.

TotalSegmentatorSegmentation.description: Organ and lesion segmentation for radiology (CT/MRI) volumes with TotalSegmentator. Prioritize this node over BiomedParse for CT organs (brain, liver, spleen, kidneys, lungs, heart, vertebrae, ...) and for intracerebral hemorrhage, which uses TotalSegmentator's dedicated cerebral_bleed model. Writes one 3D mask per requested class plus the CT intensity volume on the same voxel grid, so a CodingAgent step can compute volumes and intensity statistics.
TotalSegmentatorSegmentation.inputs: Radiology image path (NIfTI file or DICOM folder); tissue_classes=<comma-separated organ names to segment, e.g. "Kidney, Pancreas"> (empty = all organs)
TotalSegmentatorSegmentation.outputs: Tissue-Segmentation/masks/<class>/mask (3D bool, one per requested class: organs such as liver, spleen, brain, or lesions such as intracerebral hemorrhage), classes/{name,color}, and Tissue-Segmentation/image (int16 Hounsfield-unit CT volume on the same voxel grid; attrs affine, voxel_spacing_mm)

TotalSegmentatorClassification.description: Organ classification for radiology images. When classifying brain, brain structure, liver, spleen, prioritize this node over BiomedParse.
TotalSegmentatorClassification.outputs: Organ classifications (brain, brain structure, liver, spleen)

MuskEmbedding.description: Generates patch embeddings for pathology whole slides used downstream by patch classification.

MuskClassification.description: Patch-based classification model for pathology whole slides. You must use MuskEmbedding node to generate patch embeddings first.

StarDist.description: Instance segmentation of nuclei/cells on WSI with per-nucleus polygons/centroids; prerequisite for per-cell metrics and classification.

Cytoformer.description: Nuclei/cell instance segmentation (StarDist geometry) with fine-tuned H-optimus-0 per-cell embeddings [N,1536]; prerequisite for Cytoformer nuclei classification.
Cytoformer.outputs: Per-nucleus contours, centroids, and H-optimus-0 embeddings at Cell-Segmentation/embeddings [N,1536]

VISTA.description: Interactive foundation model for pixel-wise histopathology tissue segmentation; outputs dense region masks for the specified tissue class(es).
VISTA.outputs: Dense tissue masks at Tissue-Segmentation/masks/<tissue> (bool) + DZI overlay

NuClass.description: Per-nucleus classifier assigning classes (e.g., tumor_cell, lymphocyte); consumes nuclei segmentation results.

CytoformerClassification.description: Per-nucleus classifier over H-optimus-0 embeddings. With no annotations it predicts zero-shot from the selected ORGAN (low-confidence cells become Negative control); annotate cells and it trains on your own classes instead. Requires Cytoformer cell segmentation first.

CellCharter.description: Spatial-domain clustering of nuclei from spatial transcriptomics (CellCharter: PCA of nucleus expression, Delaunay neighbourhood aggregation, Gaussian-mixture clustering). Needs the slide's nucleus segmentation (NucleiSeg) and, to name the domains, the nucleus classification (NucleiClassify); takes the per-nucleus expression .h5ad that accompanies the slide. Writes a domain label per nucleus for each requested K plus marker genes per domain, so a CodingAgent step can combine the domains with the patch classification (TissueClassify) and cell classification on the TissueSeg patch grid and count multicellular structures as connected groups of patches.
CellCharter.inputs: st_path=<per-nucleus expression .h5ad with nucleus centroids> (default: the .h5ad next to the opened slide); n_clusters=<K or list, e.g. 9 or 5,6,7,8,9,10> (default 9)
CellCharter.outputs: Spatial-Omics/clusters/k<K> (int32 domain label per nucleus), Spatial-Omics/centroids (x, y per nucleus, level-0 pixels), Spatial-Omics/cluster_markers/k<K> (JSON {label: top marker genes}), Spatial-Omics/nucleus_id, Spatial-Omics/segmentation_index (row of Cell-Segmentation / Cell-Classification for each nucleus: by obs_names when they are those rows, else the nearest segmented nucleus within 8 px, -1 if none)

panel.label: Spatial transcriptomics file (.h5ad)
panel.placeholder: per-nucleus expression with centroids; empty = next to the slide

Ark.description: Task-specific zero-shot chest X-ray classifier (Ark+, Swin-L 768px). Standalone: takes the X-ray image directly, no segmentation or other nodes needed. Returns a probability per finding for several label sets (MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, ChestX-ray14, RSNA Pneumonia, VinDr-CXR, Shenzhen TB); a CodingAgent step turns the probabilities into the answer.
Ark.inputs: Chest X-ray image path (PNG/JPEG/DICOM); no other parameters
Ark.outputs: Image-Classification/predictions (52 sigmoid probabilities) aligned with Image-Classification/disease_list; Image-Classification/scores_json groups the same values per head (ChestX-ray14 head: Atelectasis, Cardiomegaly, Effusion, Infiltration, Mass, Nodule, Pneumonia, Pneumothorax, Consolidation, Edema, Emphysema, Fibrosis, Pleural_Thickening, Hernia; CheXpert/MIMIC heads: No Finding, Enlarged Cardiomediastinum, Cardiomegaly, Lung Opacity, Lung Lesion, Edema, Consolidation, Pneumonia, Atelectasis, Pneumothorax, Pleural Effusion, Pleural Other, Fracture, Support Devices)

CardiacMRSegmentation.description: Task-specific model for cardiac MRI segmentation to identify myocardium (MYO), left ventricle (LV), and right ventricle (RV); specialized for myocardial hypertrophy analysis; standalone model that does not require other nodes.
CardiacMRSegmentation.inputs: Cardiac MRI: a NIfTI volume or a DICOM folder of one series (e.g. the short-axis cine stack); optional view=LVSA|4CH|VLA|LVOT (default LVSA, the short-axis view used for LV mass and wall thickness)
CardiacMRSegmentation.outputs: <node>/voxel_mask/<view>: uint8 label map on the input image grid (LVSA: 0 background, 1 LV cavity, 2 myocardium, 3 RV cavity; other views: 0 background, 1 myocardium), with class_names and pixel spacing in the dataset attrs; for a cine DICOM series the first axis is slice-major (attrs n_slices, n_frames, slice_location_mm, trigger_time_ms; voxel_mask/slice_index and frame_index arrays)

GPT-4o Agent.description: Read the result from result files. Custom Python analysis for counts/ratios/spatial queries if needed; no visualization unless explicitly requested.

CheXzero.description: Task-specific zero-shot chest X-ray classifier (CheXzero: CLIP ViT-B/32 trained on MIMIC-CXR, checkpoint ensemble). Standalone: takes the X-ray image directly, no other nodes needed. Scores ANY finding written in words (softmax of '<finding>' vs 'no <finding>'), so pass the findings the question asks about as tissue_classes; a default list of common findings is always scored too. A CodingAgent step turns the probabilities into the answer.
CheXzero.inputs: Chest X-ray image path (PNG/JPEG/DICOM); tissue_classes=<comma-separated findings to score, e.g. "Nodule, Mass"> (optional)
CheXzero.outputs: Image-Classification/predictions (ensemble probabilities) aligned with Image-Classification/disease_list; Image-Classification/scores_json with ensemble and per-checkpoint values
